title: Domain-Decomposed Randomized Neural Networks for Partial Differential Equations in Unbounded Domains
summary: Partial differential equations on unbounded domains are challenging because the exterior region must be represented without excessive truncation error. Truncation-based methods often require problem-dependent artificial boundary conditions, while global spectral bases may be inefficient for localized structures, irregular geometries, or solutions with different near-field and far-field behaviors.
